hooks.command: case "$(jq -r '.source // "startup"' 2>/dev/null)" in startup|clear|compact) jq -n --rawfile ctx "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/memory-bank/activeContext.md" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"SessionStart",additionalContext:$ctx}}' 2>/dev/null || true ;; esac

jq -n '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreCompact",additionalContext:"Context is about to be compacted. memory-bank/ is the only thing that survives this boundary intact — if this session established anything a later session would have to rediscover, record it now per the memory-bank skill (verified facts written directly, judgments proposed to the user first)."},systemMessage:"Compacting — memory-bank/ is what crosses the boundary."}' 2>/dev/null || true
